name: context-bar
description: Context fill as a bar above the prompt, with prompt-cache hit rate, whether the cache is still warm, and how much of your plan is left when it runs low (helpers are never held for plan usage); past its hand-over point (55% for a helper, 60% for a Core; in SolveFoundry a Core's context.coreHandoffAt and a builder's context.helperPauseAt, with a no-new-job reminder from context.helperStopAt) a session is reminded each turn and may not start helpers or sessions

helperFloor.title: Show plan left below twice this %
helperFloor.description: The plan left shows once the five-hour or weekly window is below twice this share, in red below it. Helpers are never held for plan usage.
